highlights.title: Eleven killed in burst of violence during Mexican cartel leader’s capture
highlights.summary: Seven alleged cartel gunmen and four soldiers were killed in operation to arrest cartel boss Fausto Isidro Meza Flores.

highlights.title: Overturned boat carrying mourners to funeral kills at least 24 in Nigeria
highlights.summary: Police say the boat driver fled and the vessel’s manager was taken into custody.

highlights.title: Paredes desmaia em entrevista após título do Boca contra Atlético-MG; veja
highlights.summary: Volante é uma das lideranças técnicas do clube argentino, campeão sobre o Galo, após ganhar por 2 a 0, neste sábado (21), em Barranquilla, na Colômbia

highlights.title: Displaced Palestinians protest as Israeli air strikes continue in Gaza
highlights.summary: Israeli forces continue to destroy residential buildings as part of a 'gradual displacement' policy, a Gaza mayor says.

highlights.title: Bessent confirms he’s living on US military base over Iran fears
highlights.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says he’s still living at a US military base, two weeks after an Israeli warning.

highlights.title: Sul terá temporais com rajadas de vento acima de 80 km/h no domingo
highlights.summary: Nova frente fria aumenta risco de vendavais e granizo; chuva pode atingir 120 mm em áreas do Rio Grande do Sul
